cakewiki.stale: Saved copy: the wiki couldn't be reached.
cakewiki.missing: This page doesn't exist on the wiki yet.
cakewiki.bookmarks.empty: No bookmarks yet: press ☆ on a page.
cakewiki.translate.on: Translated by CakeText Translator. Click for the original.
cakewiki.translate.off_in_cakeText: Wiki pages are turned off in CakeText Translator (Where to translate).
cakewiki.translated: Translated by CakeText Translator: string files first, then its engine. Linked names stay in English. 文 shows the original.
cakewiki.blocked: %s asked to verify that you are human (Cloudflare). This usually happens when a VPN or game accelerator carries Minecraft's traffic: CakeWiki can't pass that check by itself.
cakewiki.blocked.tips: Ways out: open the page in your browser; let monumenta.wiki.gg bypass the VPN (a "direct" rule) or switch node; or verify once in the in-game browser (MCEF).
cakewiki.blocked.mcefNote: MCEF is an optional mod you install yourself: a web browser inside Minecraft that can pass the check. Its first start downloads Chromium (100+ MB). Check that your server allows it.
cakewiki.mcef.title: Pass the check on %s, then press Done
cakewiki.mcef.notReady: MCEF is still setting up its browser (its first start downloads Chromium). Try again in a moment.
cakewiki.blocked.tipsNoMcef: Ways out: open the page in your browser; or let monumenta.wiki.gg bypass the VPN (a "direct" rule) or switch node.
cakewiki.blocked.mcefModernNote: MCEF Modern is an optional Fabric mod you install yourself: a web browser inside Minecraft that can pass the check. The first time you verify, it downloads Chromium (100+ MB). Check that your server allows it.
cakewiki.mcef.failed: MCEF couldn't set up its browser (see the game log).
